scope: SRe2L++ baseline on CUB-200-2011, FGVC-Aircraft, and Stanford Cars with a ResNet18 student

invariants_across_v1_v2.input_resolution: All images are physically resized to 224x224.

v2_clarifications: SRe2L++ and its FD2 variant use the standard same-architecture evaluation protocol.
FADRM+ uses multiple teachers for distillation and one student for post-evaluation.

official_recovery_script_coverage.inference_for_missing_scripts: Aircraft and Cars use the baseline terms shared by their released SRe2L++_FD2 scripts: image LR 1e-3, 4000 iterations, R_BN 1e-3, and 2x2 patches; FD2-specific losses are omitted by running the CV-DD SRe2L++ recovery implementation.
official_recovery_script_coverage.release_breakage: The sole CUB baseline shell calls an untracked recover/recover.py, and there are no plain-baseline relabel or validation shells. It expects ResNet18.pth, which the CAL-only released squeeze scripts do not produce.
official_recovery_script_coverage.teacher_contract: The baseline shell's plain ResNet18.pth contract supports a plain backbone teacher; CAL-suffixed checkpoint loading is confined to FD2-specific recovery/relabel code.

historical_plain_teacher_protocol.initialization_bug_candidate: The historical launcher requests pretrained_bn while its trainer hard-codes pretrained_weights=False, making that flag inert. An isolated ImageNet-V1 initialization arm is retained as a one-variable intended-behavior diagnostic.
historical_plain_teacher_protocol.priority: This deleted official launcher supersedes the earlier inferred ImageNet-V1/batch4/51-epoch plain-teacher arm for the next CUB baseline attempt.

imagenet_v1_intended_behavior.single_changed_variable: Set pretrained_weights=True, making the launcher's pretrained_bn request effective; retain batch32/100 epochs/SGD 1e-2/wd 1e-4/cosine/final checkpoint.
imagenet_v1_intended_behavior.conclusion: The inert pretrained_bn/pretrained_weights=False combination is a material upstream bug candidate. The intended ImageNet-V1 arm is the primary end-to-end reproduction candidate pending IPC1 student results.

student_initialization_observation.released_validation_code: FD2/validate/train_fkd_FD2.py calls load_model(..., pretrained_weights=False, pretrained_bn=False), so ResNet18 is random initialized.
student_initialization_observation.single_variable_arm: On the same intended Aircraft rseed41 IPC1 recovery/FKD and student seed42, enable torchvision ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1 before replacing the classifier.
student_initialization_observation.conclusion: The ImageNet-initialized student's final-epoch result matches the paper target, while the released random initialization misses by 35.5 points. This is the locked intended-behavior protocol pending multi-seed and cross-dataset confirmation.

locked_protocol_results.protocol: Intended ImageNet-V1 teacher and student; historical teacher optimizer/schedule; released recovery/FKD/post-eval settings.

Aircraft_imsize224.status: all IPC1/3/5 student seeds complete; paper targets are within the observed range or within 3.6 points of the mean

equivalent_steps: Use the minimum per-class image count as the patch-source IPC (CUB=29, Aircraft=66, Cars=24).
Take source images in sorted dataset order.
Generate five RandomResizedCrop candidates at 112x112 with ratio fixed to 1 and antialiasing enabled.
Center-pad candidates to 224x224 and rank them with plain-teacher cross-entropy for the source class.
Select the four lowest-cross-entropy crops and assemble a 2x2 mosaic.
Resize the assembled mosaic using torch.nn.functional.interpolate with its default nearest-neighbor mode and save as JPEG.
intentional_non_algorithmic_extensions: Seed each class/source group deterministically for reproducible candidate generation.
Write provenance manifests and content hashes.
Apply the official minimum-count rule to Aircraft and Cars, whose plain-baseline patch shells were not released.
patch_initialization_equivalence.conclusion: No patch-generation discrepancy explains the first Aircraft IPC1 post-evaluation failure.

student_training_math.teacher_logits: Plain-teacher logits, equivalent to selecting the backbone branch in the released FD2 dual-branch FKD payload.
student_training_math.scheduler: cosine LambdaLR with eta=2 over 400 epochs
student_training_math.official_equivalence_check: The FKD branch selection, temperature transforms, KL reduction, accumulation divisor, and optimizer step ordering match FD2/validate/train_fkd_FD2.py.

core_code_stability_during_runs.runner_changes: Only post-generation audits and expected validation-image counts were added; numerical recovery, relabel, and post-evaluation arguments were unchanged.

not_disclosed_by_either_version: post-evaluation optimizer learning rate and weight decay
reproduction_policy: Use the deleted official plain-teacher launcher for the next CUB baseline arm, retain completed ImageNet-V1 teacher runs as explicitly labeled reconstruction evidence, use released FD2/CV-DD values for still-undisclosed recovery/relabel settings, and treat the unchanged v1/v2 main-table values as the primary targets.
